exposure: Socioeconomic position (Scottish Index for Multiple Deprivation - SIMD)
Emergency admissions for bronchiolitis before age 1 year
outcome: Asthma/wheeze (trajectories: early-transient, early-persistent, intermediate-onset, no asthma/wheeze)
cohort: The study cohort comprised 83,853 children born in Scotland between January 1, 2007, and June 31, 2008.
finding: The majority of socioeconomic disparity in chronic asthma prevalence by deprivation level remains unexplained, although the elimination of bronchiolitis requiring hospital admission could reduce these risk differences by 17.9% to 21.2%.
